metadata.title: refactor(rust): replace rustls with native-tls for license compliance
metadata.author: lucarlig

description:
## 🚀 Summary
Replaced rustls TLS implementation with native-tls (OpenSSL-based) across all Rust packages to ensure license compliance.

---

## 🧪 Checks

- [x] `make lint` passes (Rust packages only)
- [x] `make test` passes (Rust builds verified)
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated (if user-facing)

---

## 📓 Notes

**Changes:**
- `tools_rust/wrapper`: Switched reqwest from rustls to native-tls features
- `mcp-servers/rust/filesystem-server`: Updated dev-dependencies to use native-tls
- Both Cargo.lock files updated to remove rustls and all related dependencies

**Verification:**
- Both packages build successfully in release mode
- Dependency trees confirmed free of rustls
- native-tls properly integrated via reqwest

**Impact:**
- No functional changes to runtime behavior
- TLS operations now use system-native OpenSSL instead of rustls
- License compliance achieved
- Net reduction: 703 lines removed from lock files (cleaner dependency tree)
